مَسخُولٌ Pronounced to be low, base, vile, mean, or contemptible: (K:) like مَخْسُولٌ. (TA.) ―
-b2-
Unknown: (S, O, K:) and so مَخْسُولٌ. (O.) A poet says, “تُرَى فِى السَّمَآءِ وَلَا تُعْلَمُ
وَأَنْتُمْ كَوَاكِبُ مَسْخُولَةٌ
” [And ye are stars unknown, that are seen in the sky but not known]: or, as some relate it, مَخْسُولَةٌ. (S, O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
